description: Teacher labels for stage 1: Opus labels a fixed sample of 100 training chapters place by place under the exam's own drafting instructions (v1) and guide (1.1), and novel_ner.teacher turns the answers into a weak-label build (labels_T) next to the weak S3 labels of the same chapters (labels_W), so the tagger's A1/A2 and B1/B2 arms differ in labels only. Sample: the training pool is chapters 1-780 of the training snapshot minus the 31 dev chapters (749 chapters), sorted by number and cut into 8 equal-count ranges; novel_ner.sample_test.stratified_order (seed 20261004) spreads the ranges evenly, and the first 100 chapters form packs teach_b01..teach_b20 of 5. A dev pilot pack (teach_dev_b01) holds 5 of the dev chapters (seed 20261004) for measuring the teacher's agreement with the dev answers (GPT-drafted, user-adjudicated: the exam setter's conventions, not absolute quality). Pilot first: teach_b01, teach_b02 and teach_dev_b01 (10 training chapters + 5 dev chapters); the other 18 packs follow once the pilot's checks pass (JSON valid, few unlocated mentions, pending share, overlaps, agreement with the weak labels, and a training run on the converted labels). Opus is the teacher control, not a ceiling (a student may score above it). Material scope (the material-scope rules): the teacher sees instructions + guide + chapter text only, never the name knowledge table, answers, adjudication records or review lists; the labels builder opens nothing under data/gold (tests check). No pack may hold a chapter after 780, a dev chapter (except the dev pack), a test, dev2 or test2 chapter. Costs: 21 Opus calls at about 1.0 USD list price each (within the subscription; mind the monthly cap).
gold_dev_note: read by `check` alone, for the dev pilot pack's scores; `labels` never opens it
